results.text: Hey sorry I accidentally sent my verification code to your number, can you send it back to me? it's a 6 digit code, just got sent to you
results.headline: Don't send that code - it would let someone take over your account.

results.text: Are you at your desk? I need a quick favour, I'm in a meeting and can't talk. Need 5 Apple gift cards (£100 each) for a client today, I'll reimburse you. Send me photos of the codes once you've got them. - David (CEO)
results.headline: This is a scam: a fake boss asking you to buy gift cards.

results.text: We saw you lost funds to an investment platform. Our blockchain recovery team has traced your USDT and can return it within 72 hours. A recovery fee of 10% is payable upfront. Reply RECOVER to start.
results.headline: This is a fund recovery scam targeting people who already lost money.

results.text: Hi, the flat is still available. I'm working abroad so I can't show it, but if you send the deposit (£950) and first month by bank transfer I'll post the keys by DHL. Lots of interest so need to decide today.
results.headline: This is a fake rental: don't send any deposit or rent.

results.text: Hello this is Evri, we have tried to deliver your parcel twice. Please reply with your full name, address and date of birth so we can confirm the redelivery slot.
results.headline: This is very likely a fake Evri message after your personal details.

results.text: Hi Mark, quick one - we've moved our business account to Starling after issues with our old bank. Please use the new details for invoice INV-2291 due Friday: Sort code 60-83-71, account 22918476, name Greenfield Supplies Ltd. Thanks, Claire (Accounts)
results.headline: Changed bank details for an invoice are a classic fraud trick. Check first.

results.text: omg is this you in this video?? 😳 everyone's sharing it https://vid-share.live/watch?v=Xk29a
results.headline: This is a classic trick to steal your account. Don't click the link.

results.text: Hi! I'm Emma from TalentBridge recruitment. Your profile is a great fit for a remote data review role, £300-£450/day, flexible hours, no experience needed. Can I add you on WhatsApp to explain? Training is paid after a small refundable starter deposit.
